title: Jam's Rabbit Eyes
description: A middle ground for rabbit eyes. Making their eyes visible on both the front and the side
body:
I do think it was a bit weird for a rabbit to have their eyes stay the way they were, but moving them completely to the side will make them look strange on the front. So why not do both?

## About
**Jam's Rabbit Eyes** tweaks the rabbits' eye placement so they can be seen both in the front and on the sides.

## Things Changed
Rabbits:
- Brown
- White
- Black
- White Splotched
- Gold
- Salt
- "Toast"
  
Killer bunnies are unchanged.

## How to Use
Just toss the zip file in your resourcepack folder and load it. You do not need any mods for this resource pack to work.
